users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Members of this organization and the roles assigned to them.
users.scopeHint: If a station is chosen, this role only applies to that station for this user — they won't see or access the others.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: A role is a permission template — actual assignment happens on the Users page. An individual deny always overrides what a role grants.
roles.permissionsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No permission} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
roles.ownerImmutable: The Owner role holds every permission by construction and cannot be edited.
roles.noPermissionToManage: You cannot edit this role: you don't hold some of its current permissions yourself, or you lack the right to manage roles.
roles.empty: No role defined for this organization.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what, on what, and when — filtered to your access scope.
audit.empty: No action recorded for this period.
audit.noAccess: You do not have permission to view the audit log.

grants.title: Individual grants — {user}
grants.subtitle: An individual grant is independent from the displayed role: a "deny" set here always blocks access, even if a role allows it elsewhere. A scoped "allow" can unlock a specific resource without changing the user's role.
grants.empty: No individual grant for this user.
grants.revokeConfirm: Revoke this grant? Any delegation issued from it will be revoked with it.
grants.resourceTypePlaceholder: Scope type (e.g. station) — empty = whole organization
